Definition
[Sobolev conjugate exponent] 1. ch5:5.6-def-1\group Sobolev Inequalities If $1 \le p < n$, the Sobolev conjugate of $p$ is \[ (8) \quad p^* := \frac{np}{n - p}. \] Note that \[ (9) \quad \frac{1}{p^*} = \frac{1}{p} - \frac{1}{n}, \quad p^* > p. \]
